images.note: Real diagram from Atlassian's official Git tutorials (alt text "New merge commit node"), served from Atlassian's own asset CDN. Shows Common base, Main tip, and Feature tip all feeding into a new merge commit — exactly what git merge produces: history preserved, both lines still visible.

Real diagram from Atlassian's official Git tutorials (alt text "Rebasing feature branch into main"), served from Atlassian's own asset CDN. Shows the Feature branch's commits replayed as brand-new commits on top of Main's tip, producing a single linear line — exactly what git rebase produces.
